headlines.text: Dow closes up 3.03% at 53,356.12 in its best day since April 2025, S&P 500 and Nasdaq also rally as Democrats' sweep of Congress eases Washington policy uncertainty
Nvidia, Micron and Tesla tumble while Microsoft and Apple hit record highs as Democrats' midterm sweep stirs fears of new data-center regulation
ADP: private employers added 86,000 jobs in October, topping forecasts, ahead of Friday's delayed official jobs report
Oil prices sink roughly 7% as Democrats' midterm sweep of Congress removes a layer of Washington policy risk
AMD posts record $13.38 billion Q3 revenue as data-center sales nearly double on AI chip demand, guides Q4 revenue to about $17 billion
Qualcomm shares slide after hours despite an in-line fiscal Q4 beat, as weak fiscal Q1 revenue guidance overshadows the results
Snap shares sink more than 10% after hours on a third-quarter revenue and daily-active-user miss
